opportunities.name: Hunted mixed-stat pounce
opportunities.objective: Test an AD/AP hybrid cougar follow-up after a Hunt.
opportunities.mechanic: Aspect of the Cougar retains 0.5 AD[statFormula=2] plus 0.3 AP on Pounce and 0.7 AD[statFormula=2] plus 0.55 AP on Swipe. Trinity gives actual Takedown attacks a physical Spellblade packet; Nashor supports human E attack-speed windows. Hunt grants reach and a Pounce cooldown reduction, not unlimited jumps.
opportunities.requiredState: Land human Q or W, retain the four-second Hunt and record form/R rank.
opportunities.failure: A missed spear leaves the melee item investment without safe access.
opportunities.test: Separate human spear, cougar Pounce/Swipe, Takedown and item packets at fixed R rank.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The retained AD statFormula flag is not permission to treat every cougar hit as ordinary physical attack damage.

opportunities.name: Primal relay buffer
opportunities.objective: Use missing-health healing and attack speed to support a ranged carry between spear threats.
opportunities.mechanic: Human E supplies 0.35 AP healing increased up to twice at low health plus seven seconds of attack speed. Ardent and Staff can add ally buffs after that heal; Helia asks whether prior spear/trap damage charges can be cashed by E. Q still threatens distant opponents and traps reveal Hunted targets.
opportunities.requiredState: An ally can use the seven-second buff; damage a champion before a needed E heal.
opportunities.failure: Support income and weak engage can make the personal utility too expensive.
opportunities.test: Compare ally attack count, E healing and Helia charge consumption after a spear hit.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Human E healing does not require cougar attacks or inherit cougar execution amplification.

ruledOut.reason: Human Q is a thrown magic-damage spell; it is not documented as a Spellblade-consuming attack.

unknowns: Cougar tooltip coefficients reference R; retained R calculations were inspected. Takedown missing-health multiplier and helper resolution need in-game confirmation.

builds.name: Hunted mixed-stat pounce
builds.summary: Test an AD/AP hybrid cougar follow-up after a Hunt.
builds.goal: Test an AD/AP hybrid cougar follow-up after a Hunt.
builds.hypothesis: Aspect of the Cougar retains 0.5 AD[statFormula=2] plus 0.3 AP on Pounce and 0.7 AD[statFormula=2] plus 0.55 AP on Swipe. Trinity gives actual Takedown attacks a physical Spellblade packet; Nashor supports human E attack-speed windows. Hunt grants reach and a Pounce cooldown reduction, not unlimited jumps.
testPlan: Required state: Land human Q or W, retain the four-second Hunt and record form/R rank.
Separate human spear, cougar Pounce/Swipe, Takedown and item packets at fixed R rank.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A missed spear leaves the melee item investment without safe access.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The retained AD statFormula flag is not permission to treat every cougar hit as ordinary physical attack damage.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Nashor's Tooth, Riftmaker, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula: Human Form: Nidalee throws her javelin, dealing [70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage, increased up to [(70 / 90 / 110 / 130 / 150 + (0.5) × AP) × (3.25)] magic damage based on distance flown.

Human Form: Nidalee restores [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.35) × AP] Health increased up to [(50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.35) × AP) × ((1 + 1))] based on missing Health and grants them [(0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7) × 100]% Attack Speed for [7] seconds.

Passive: While in Human Form, applying Hunted refreshes this Ability's Cooldown.

Human Form: Nidalee transforms into Cougar Form, gaining melee Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.

Cougar Form: Nidalee transforms into Human Form, gaining ranged Attacks and replacing her Active Abilities.

Human Form: Nidalee places an invisible trap for 2 minutes. When an enemy walks over it, they are dealt [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 + (0.05) × AP] magic damage per second for [4] seconds.

[characterLevelBreakpoints(start=4, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 2.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + 0] traps may be active at once.

Nidalee starts with a rank in Aspect of the Cougar. 

Nidalee gains @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS@% Move Speed for 2 seconds when entering Brush, increased to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS*3@% Move Speed while moving toward enemy champions.

Hitting champions or jungle monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack marks them as Hunted for 4 seconds. While an enemy is Hunted, they are revealed with True Sight and Nidalee gains @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS@% Move Speed, increased to @spell.AspectOfTheCougar:PassivePercentMS*3@% Move Speed toward the Hunted enemy.
